newsitem.title: BRAZIL: Brazil sells 3.043 bln reais in Treasury papers.
newsitem.headline: Brazil sells 3.043 bln reais in Treasury papers.

text.p: Brazil's Central Bank, on behalf of the National Treasury, raised 3.043 billion reais during an auction Thursday of two series of National Treasury Letters known as LTNs, dealers said.
A total of 1.814 billon reais of 184-day LTNs, due in Feb 15 1998, was sold at an overnight call money rate of 2.275 percent a month.
The Central Bank also sold 1.229 billion reais of 365-day, due in Aug 15 1998, at a call money rate of 2.378 percent a month.
